categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies orphan announcement candidate evaluation in src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents redundant missing-parent lookups from stalling peer message processing when peers announce large orphans they cannot resolve. For orphans with thousands of inputs announced by an exhausted peer, the author's regtest benchmarks show inv processing time dropping from 14.5–16.2 ms down to 0.19–0.22 ms.
